title: fix(app-shell): label the approval decision panel's record summary "As submitted" (#27502)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgDFH4S5pR1C8YvYCWWsZfXx)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：审批请求页决策面板里的记录摘要加上「提交时的内容」标题（十个语言包），摘要本身的数据与读取不变。
- 为什么改：摘要是目标记录提交时的快照，状态条读的是审批请求本身；审批后两者状态不同，没有标题时快照读起来像记录的当前状态，页面自相矛盾。
- 风险与回滚：只加一个标题和一个语言包键，无新读取、无契约变化；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`RecordSnapshotSummary.tsx`（section 与标题）、`ApprovalDecisionPanel.decidedSnapshot-27502.test.tsx`、`i18n/src/locales/zh.ts` 新键。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-decision/`，预期 6 个文件 57 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #27502

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- **The summary is headed "As submitted".** `RecordSnapshotSummary`, the decision panel's summary of the request's record snapshot, is now a `section` whose heading reads the new pack row `approvalsInbox.snapshotAsSubmitted` ("As submitted", zh "提交时的内容") in the muted label style of the panel's "Waiting on"; the heading is the section's accessible name (`aria-labelledby`). It is drawn only when the summary draws content, and at any request status: it names the source, not a status.
- **Nothing else moves.** The rows, the lead amount, the reads (the request row's `payload` / `payload_display` and the target object's definition) and the redaction are unchanged. No record is read; the record's current values stay on the Details tab's `record_id` pointer card.
- **Copy.** One key in all ten `@object-ui/i18n` packs (en, ar, de, es, fr, ja, ko, pt, ru, zh).
- **Docs.** The headers of `RecordSnapshotSummary.tsx` and `ApprovalDecisionPanel.tsx` (part 1) say the panel draws the submitted snapshot (objectstack#10749) and why it is labelled; the app-shell README's panel section says the same. One patch changeset for `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`.

## Why

The served `sys_approval_request_detail` page draws two faces that read two different rows:

- the `record:highlights` strip reads the REQUEST row (`process_label`, `status`, `current_step_label`, `submitter_id`, `updated_at`), so after a decision it reads "Status Approved";
- the decision panel's summary reads `request.payload`, the target record as SUBMITTED, kept at rest as the request's evidence of what was submitted and served redacted per reader (objectstack#10749, ruling record 5377367175, Option B). It keeps "Status Submitted" and "Approved 0.00".

Unlabelled, the snapshot read as the record's current state beside the request's status. The fork between a live read of the target and the labelled snapshot was ruled B (ruling record 6499914328 on this card): keep the snapshot, label it as the submitted values.

## Tests

- `ApprovalDecisionPanel.decidedSnapshot-27502.test.tsx`, four pins over the served row shape:
  - a decided request (`status: 'approved'`, the snapshot's own `status: 'submitted'` under a declared `select` field): the summary is the region the pack row names, its status row reads `Submitted`, and nobody is waited on;
  - a pending request carries the heading too;
  - CONTROL: a snapshot with only undeclared keys draws no summary and no heading;
  - the key is defined and non-empty in all ten packs.

<details><summary>Ablation (one-shot, not kept)</summary>

Fix committed first. `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` deleted the heading's copy expression in `RecordSnapshotSummary.tsx` (anchor x1 -> x0, blob `c05edc2b` -> `8ff34b0a`): the decided and pending pins turned red, the control and the ten-pack pin stayed green (2 failed, 2 passed). Restored: blob after restore equals HEAD `c05edc2b`, `git diff HEAD` empty. The subject resolves from source (relative import; `@object-ui/i18n` is aliased to `src` in `ui/vitest.config.mts`), so no `dist` leg applies.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The card's acceptance ("the page does not contradict itself") is met by labelling the source**, per ruling 6499914328: the summary now says it holds the submitted values, so it no longer reads against the request's status in the strip.
- **Correction to the triage line.** Triage said the summary should read "the same read the strip uses". It cannot: the strip reads the request row, never the target record. The target's current values are on the Details tab's pointer card, which an approver without read access to the target may be refused; the snapshot is how such an approver sees what they decide on (objectstack#10749).
- **The x3 beside "1 eligible approver" is not this card.** `PendingApprovers` draws each chip's slot count from `approverChips` (one person holding three quorum slots is one chip "x3"), while the progress line counts distinct people (`eligibleApproverCount`, objectui#12781). Different read, untouched here; class: a (user-visible copy with no explanation of the count) · reach: this card's own walkthrough (QA-source #27377 track 1) on the served request page · dedupe words: approver chip count, quorum slots, eligible approver, x3. The seat files it separately.
- **Serial constraint.** Open PR #27533 edits `snapshotSummaryPlan.ts`; this PR does not touch that file.
- The after-PR assignee and review request are skipped on purpose: the maintainer's rule is that a PR reaches a human only after the seat accepts it.
